title: Training Notes: The E-Disclosure Discount on the Mortgage Loan File Application Fee
content:
**The rule.** Where the intent to proceed on a Mortgage Loan File was given through the e-sign portal and no Loan Estimate on the file was delivered by mail or in person, 40.00 USD is taken off the application fee; where the intent to proceed was given through the e-sign portal but a Loan Estimate on the file was delivered by mail or in person, 20.00 USD is taken off; where the intent to proceed was not given through the e-sign portal nothing is taken off.

Both facts are read from the file's disclosure history: the delivery method recorded on the intent to proceed, and the delivery method of every Loan Estimate on the file, initial and revised.

## Questions answered

**The borrower e-signed the intent to proceed and every Loan Estimate went through the e-sign portal. What comes off?** 40.00 USD.

**The intent to proceed was given in the portal, but a revised Loan Estimate was mailed. What comes off?** 20.00 USD — one Loan Estimate delivered by mail or in person is enough to move the file to the lower figure.

**The borrower gave intent to proceed verbally to the loan officer, and all Loan Estimates were e-delivered. What comes off?** Nothing; the intent to proceed was not given through the e-sign portal.

| Intent to proceed through the e-sign portal | Any Loan Estimate delivered by mail or in person | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 40.00 USD |
| yes | yes | 20.00 USD |
| no | either | nothing |
